english.title: Corrupt practice - undue influence on voting on account of person's vote/refraining to vote
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of a corrupt practice, namely undue influence, in that you

(A)_[used or threatened to use violence against a person,]_
(B)_[damaged or destroyed or threatened to damage or destroy the property of a person,]_
(C)_[damaged or threatened to damage the reputation of a person,]_
(D)_[caused or threatened to cause financial loss to a person,]_
(E)_[caused spiritual injury to, or placed undue spiritual pressure on, a person,]_
(F)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..) designed to intimidate a person,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) on account of

(G)_[a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), having voted in a particular way or refrained from voting]_
(H)_[you assuming a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to have voted in a particular way or to have refrained from voting]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections114A(1), (3) and (4) and 168of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) An activity is carried out by a person ("P") if it is carried out by P, by P jointly with one or more persons, or by one or more persons on P's behalf or with P's authority or consent (section 114A(5) of the Elections Act 1983. (ii) This offence does not apply to elections in Scotland and Wales under the Local Government Act 1972 (section 114A(7)).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months and/or fine.
Indictment: maximum 1 year imprisonment and/or fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see Schedule 1 to the Interpretation Act 1978 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Complex - see section 176 of the Representation of the People Act 1983
